Title: n8n: Expression sandbox escape via arrow-function bodies enabling command execution
Description: An authenticated user with permission to create or modify workflows could abuse crafted expressions using arrow functions to bypass the expression sandbox, triggering unintended system command execution on the host running n8n.
AffectedVersions: All versions before 2.31.5, all versions starting from 2.32.0 before 2.32.1
NotImpacted: All versions starting from 2.31.5 before 2.32.0, all versions starting from 2.32.1
